Which by the LORD’S command he eat,
Newton printed the hymn under Revelation 10. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

1Then I saw another mighty angel coming down from heaven, wrapped in a cloud, with a rainbow above his head. His face was like the sun, and his legs were like pillars of fire. 2He held in his hand a small scroll, which lay open. He placed his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land. 3Then he cried out in a loud voice like the roar of a lion. And when he cried out, the seven thunders sounded their voices. 4When the seven thunders had spoken, I was about to put it in writing. But I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Seal up what the seven thunders have said, and do not write it down.” … 7 more verses REVELATION 10 · ITS FIRST VERSES · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ REVELATION 10
